name: Falcon
headline: Site manager by day, futures trader by discipline, and a husband and father working toward a life of freedom back home.
intro: I'm a Filipino from Lapu-Lapu, Cebu, working in Singapore as a site manager in civil engineering. I trade NQ and ES futures with a mechanical, rules-based system, and this site is where I keep the record: every journal entry, every playbook, every tool I build to trade better.

chapters.label: Where it started
chapters.title: Lapu-Lapu, Cebu
chapters.text: Write about your childhood, your family and what shaped you: where you grew up, what you studied, and what first pushed you to work hard.

chapters.label: Building abroad
chapters.title: An OFW in Singapore
chapters.text: Today I manage civil and infrastructure project sites: programmes, method statements, risk assessments and keeping several sites moving at once. The job taught me that big outcomes come from small steps done right, every day. That's the same way I approach the markets.

chapters.label: The trading desk
chapters.title: From discretion to a system
chapters.text: Write how you started trading and the early lessons. Now I trade NQ and ES with defined setups, journal every session, and automate parts of my process in NinjaTrader 8.

chapters.label: The mission
chapters.title: Operation Freedom
chapters.text: The goal is to return home to the Philippines for good: to be a present father, build a self-sustaining life with my wife, and make trading a real source of income alongside small businesses. Faith is at the centre of it. This website is the public record of that journey.

principles.title: Discipline
principles.text: Follow the rules, especially when it's hard. No setup, no trade.

principles.title: Process
principles.text: Judge the execution, not the outcome. The journal keeps me honest.

principles.title: Faith
principles.text: Purpose bigger than the P&L. Gratitude in wins, humility in losses.

principles.title: Family
principles.text: Every trade serves one goal: time and freedom with the people who matter.
